'''Dimitris Perrikos''' ({{langx|el|Δημήτρης Περρίκος}}, born December 1935 in [[Piraeus]], [[Greece]]) is a [[Greece|Greek]] chemist working for the [[United Nations]] since 1975.<ref name="enet">{{cite news | url = http://news.kathimerini.gr/4dcgi/_w_articles_world_2_03/08/2003_72286 | title = Δεν βρήκαμε αποδείξεις στο Iράκ | language = Greek | newspaper = [[Eleftherotypia]] | date = 3 August 2003 | accessdate = 15 May 2011 | url-status = dead | archiveurl = https://web.archive.org/web/20120310145307/http://news.kathimerini.gr/4dcgi/_w_articles_world_2_03/08/2003_72286 | archivedate = 10 March 2012 }}</ref> He was the second Chairman of the [[United Nations Monitoring, Verification and Inspection Commission]] (UNMOVIC), succeeding Dr. [[Hans Blix]] in June 2003,<ref name="Schneider">{{cite news|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2003/06/11/world/world-briefing-united-nations-new-chief-for-weapons-inspections.html?src=pm|title=New Chief for Weapons Inspections|last=Schneider|first=Daniel B.|date=11 June 2003|work=[[The New York Times]]|page=8|accessdate=17 March 2011}}</ref> and serving until UNMOVIC's dissolution in 2007. He is the son of the Greek Air Force officer and [[Greek Resistance|Resistance]] fighter [[Kostas Perrikos]], founder of [[PEAN]].
